pr.title: Normalize tight interpolation rows and audit cubic-residue filtering
pr.body:
## Problem and resulting behavior

Tight interpolation rows retained scalar redundancy, and the cubic-residue shortcut lacked a discriminator on the original point input regime. This update supplies complete dominant-monic norm normalization, exact finite colored extraction for a supplied nonzero tight row, and an actual odd-subgroup obstruction to the bare residue filter. [pcc:unverified]

Every tight norm solution has an even branch with monic u and norm equal to the nodal polynomial, or an odd branch with monic v and its negative. Both degrees and row equations are preserved with explicit recovery. With distinct record x's, the supplied-row zero filters are singleton and normalization preserves them. Fast nonzero-row discovery remains open. [pcc:unverified]

On actual Mathlib short-Weierstrass Point semantics in characteristic other than2, every colored tuple of nonzero points killed by a common odd q passes the cubic-square congruence, with a witness of degree at most2. Public halving, tangent/slope/addX/xRep, product and polynomial remainder laws give the endpoint. The symbolic mixed alphaG+betaH application uses qG=qH=0 and no hidden scalar. The BARE residue test therefore cannot prune these tuples; full polynomial-square quotient, extra monicity and degree constraints remain separate. [pcc:unverified]

## Validation and limits

- Twenty-nine maintained owner laws across two new modules and seven symbolic applications compile. Twenty-nine named axiom prints use standard dependencies; final actual002 and mixed002 outputs are empty. [pcc:unverified]
- Final local all-tracked canonical gate001:635/0/0. Delta38 from597 is29 owner laws+7 applications+2 defining equations, with no removals. Default-heartbeat/interface failures are retained, with no proof-limit/trust/inventory/linter exception or native_decide. [pcc:unverified]
- All449 hashes match, including406 older pins;23 rows retain published23322-row/main0179-row exact byte/parsed prefixes. Scoped attestation `PCC-20261116-c3231e` remains unverified, with no independently signed verdict or identity certificate. [pcc:unverified]

The new formal point-DOUBLING bridge is distinct from the still-HAND principal-divisor/pole/group-ZERO-SUM bridge from tight functions. Fast discovery, original useful relation yield and the complete classical subexponential prime-field ECDLP criterion remain unmet. Higher f-adic lifting versus degree-restricted reconstruction is a proposed next discriminator, not a checked result. [pcc:unverified]

No scientific/numerical/field/curve/Sage/LLL/native qualification, paid job, image build/pull or control execution. The earlier control remains UNEXECUTED; live cost and actual runtime/caller/capacity/custody admission remain missing. The2USD proposal is not a grant or known balance. [pcc:unverified]

Latest report: docs/monic-norm-selector-20261116.md. Frozen source/plan/report/PDF/control/raw evidence, journal multiplicities and the unrelated Velu probe are preserved.
